questions.question: When King Balak of Moab urged Balaam to come and curse Israel, what did Balaam say he must do?

answers.text: Speak only the word God gives him
Speak only once he has been paid
Speak only to the king in private

questions.question: King Balak of Moab wanted Balaam to curse Israel. What did Balak complain Balaam had done to them instead?
Balaam told King Balak of Moab that God is not a man. What was his point?

answers.text: God does not lie or change His mind
God cannot be seen by any people
God only speaks through His prophets
